parsed.explanation: No trans-specific crime, no documented police/border/facility targeting. The parent rights framework, decriminalisation of private same-sex conduct, and anti-discrimination clauses provide a moderately protective legal climate; hotels welcoming gay tourists are positive but not trans-specific. The age-of-consent and marriage exclusions affect same-sex relationships, a secondary sexuality-law signal rather than an active trans exposure. Thin, dated sources leave gender-identity protection, custody, care and border practice unresolved; absence of evidence is not safety, but the worst documented features are open questions and social opacity, not tier-1/2 state exposure. Rating sits at the lower Reduced-Risk boundary.
